study type: Cohort study with instrumental variable analysis
cohort: The study participants were women in Austria giving birth at parity 0.
finding: A non-planned cesarean delivery at parity 0 decreases lifecycle fertility by almost 13.6%, which translates into a temporary increase in maternal employment.
mod_finding: A non-planned cesarean delivery at parity 0 was found to decrease lifecycle fertility by almost 13.6%.
